name: get-general-practitioner-info
title: Get organization information for a healthcare provider with provider number
description:
The operation resolves the input organization(s) to the shared organization for the one or more organizations that have the given provider number. 
The Organization returned depends on how many Organization exist in the service with that provider number. When a single Organization has the provider number that Organization is returned. 
When multiple Organization resources have the same provider number, the shared parent Organization is returned. 
If no shared parent Organization exists, the newest Organization is returned. 
Active Organization resources are preferred. When no active Organization has the provider number, inactive Organization resources are considered as a fallback. 
An OperationOutcome with an explicit error is returned in case the provider number is not exactly 6 digits, in case the input organizations have different provider numbers, or in case no Organization has the provider number. 
A typical use of the operation is to get name, address and telecom details for a general practitioner. Many provider numbers are assigned to a single organization but some provider numbers are shared by multiple entities (organizations) within in a common practice.

parameter.name: organization
parameter.documentation:
Reference to Organization. 
The provider number needs to be stated in the input reference with Reference.identifier.system: urn:oid:1.2.208.176.1.4 and Reference.identifier.value set to the provider number.

parameter.name: return
parameter.documentation:
The Organization that has the given provider number. 
When multiple Organization resources have the same provider number, the shared parent Organization is returned, or the newest Organization if there is no shared parent. 
When no active Organization has the provider number, inactive Organization resources are considered as a fallback.
